login.title: Channel Partner Login

login.heroTitle: Grow your real-estate business with every lead you bring
login.heroIntro: One portal to register customers with builders, keep the credit for your leads and follow them through to booking.

register.title: Register leads in seconds
register.text: Submit your customer and the project they are interested in.

protect.title: Duplicate protection
protect.text: Your lead stays yours for the protection period, so no one else can claim the same customer.

track.text: See each lead's status and full history, from first contact to booking.

handover.title: Credit at booking
handover.text: When a customer books, the lead is handed over to the builder with you recorded as the source partner.
